title: Execution of BG/LUT
text: 4.34 Execution of BG/LUT (a) Authorisation holder shall execute Bank Guarantee / Legal Undertaking, as the case maybe, in terms of paragraph 2.29 of Handbook of Procedures. (b) In case BG / LUT has been redeemed, Advance Authorisation holder can get duty free inputs processed from any manufacturer under Actual User condition as per job work regulations prescribed in terms of provisions of GST Acts under intimation to the Customs authority.
